newsitem.title: FRANCE: Injured Husseini appeals for Israeli gesture.
newsitem.headline: Injured Husseini appeals for Israeli gesture.

text.p: Palestinian minister Faisal Husseini, injured by Israeli police during a demonstration in Jerusalem, appealed to the Israeli government on Thursday to seal a disputed tunnel under the Old City of Jerusalem.
"The Israelis must take some intelligent decisions," Husseini, the senior PLO leader in Jerusalem, said in an interview with France 2 television at the hospital where he is being treated.

"First, close the tunnel. Second, implement immediately the terms of the interim (Palestinian self-rule) agreement. Then start negotiations on the permanent settlement of the conflict. They must announce this immediately."
He added, according to a French translation: "If they don't do so, I do not see how this peace process can fail to collapse in the face of this situation."
At least 44 Palestinians and 11 Israelis have been killed in two days of widespread violence since Israel opened the archaeological tunnel close to the al-Aqsa Mosque, on of Islam's holiest shrines.
